status.summary: UFC women's strawweight champion. She won the vacant title over Virna Jandiroba at UFC 321 (Oct 25, 2025, Abu Dhabi; 48-47, 48-47, 49-46) after Zhang Weili moved up to flyweight (Zhang then lost to Valentina Shevchenko in Nov 2025), and made her first defence against Gillian Robertson at UFC 330 (Aug 15, 2026, Philadelphia; 49-46, 49-46, 48-47). Afterwards she said she was unhappy with the performance and her cardio. Nothing is booked as of Nov 6, 2026. No. 2 Tatiana Suarez meets No. 3 Jandiroba at UFC Vegas 124 (UFC Fight Night: Cortes Acosta vs Walker, Nov 7, 2026), and Suarez says a win should earn her the Dern fight. No injury reported. Pro MMA record 17-5 (Wikipedia, UFCalendar); UFC 12-5. Age 33.

style.summary: A submission specialist who has made it work at the top of the division. Her striking is below average and her takedown entries rarely succeed, but once she is on top she holds position for long spells and hunts armbars and leg locks. Strikers who keep the fight standing have beaten her on volume, and Andrade knocked her out.

moves.notes: Weights follow the schema example and src/director.js: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1; spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for specials. Target split from fighters.json: time-decayed significant attempts are 85.9% head, 8.6% body, 5.4% legs (landed 73.0/15.3/11.8); career attempts 87.0/8.1/5.0; women's strawweight league 75.6/15.2/9.2. So she throws to the head more than the division does, and her leg strikes are few but accurate (11 of 11 vs Robertson, 13 of 13 vs Jandiroba, 11 of 11 vs Ribas in 2025). Some of these may be kicks thrown from the floor, but ufcstats does not say, so calf and inside are split evenly. Fact-check (Nov 6, 2026): overhand was cut from 0.24 to 0.14, with the difference moved to cross (+0.05) and hook (+0.05), because the claim of a signature looping overhand right could not be sourced; 0.14 stays a little above the director default because she is short-armed (63 in reach at 5 ft 4 in, ufcstats). Body kicks lead the body group as a judgment. Knees and elbows are near zero: 7% of her decayed landed strikes are in the clinch, and her ground strikes are not split by technique. No published technique breakdown was found (re-checked Nov 6, 2026), so the within-group splits are judgments. Medium-low confidence.

engine_notes.note: Top game: time-decayed control is 278 s per 15 min (division 185), and 16.5% of her landed strikes come on the ground (division 9.8%). Submission attempts are 1.01 per 15 career (division 0.40). All five submission wins are on the arm, back or leg from top or guard: armbar x3, kneebar, RNC.
Takedown offence is volume over accuracy: 4.88 attempts and 1.07 landed per 15 career (22%). The time-decayed rate is better (32%, 1.44 landed per 15), helped by 4 of 6 vs Robertson.
Chin: 6 knockdowns absorbed in 17 UFC fights, 1.17 per 100 head strikes absorbed career (division 0.33), and one KO loss. Knockdown power is low: 2 knockdowns scored, 0 KO/TKO wins.

Pace in 5-round fights (6 fights): 1.00, 0.70, 1.22, 1.06, 1.07 of round 1, against a division curve of 1.00, 0.88, 1.15, 1.21, 1.15. No late fade. She took R5 vs Jandiroba 35-23 with 11 of 11 ground strikes.
Elo 1657, third among strawweights who have fought since Nov 2024 (Zhang Weili 1706, Tatiana Suarez 1703).
